notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello -

A very small update, but it smooths out a few rough edges and clears up some confusion:[/p][list][*][p]Hammer can no longer break the computer. That was never the intended behavior, and it should now function as originally designed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “Are you sure you want to quit?” dialog to prevent accidental exits.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing ESC now cleanly exits the computer interface. This should feel more natural and intuitive. [/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you, once again, for playing and sharing Hellkind. Even a tiny patch like this comes from paying attention to the way you’re experiencing the game. Every bug report, suggestion, and kind message matters.[/p][p][/p][p][i]From the terminal.[/i][/p][p]Emir Arkman / Motamot[/p]
